page-title.purpose: One per view, top of each tab (.view-title).

body.purpose: Default running text throughout the app.

label.purpose: Secondary labels, meta text, uppercase section headers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (Fetch, Convert, Compress, etc.)
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.52 0.195 35); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.44 0.165 35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.195 35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button (Clear, Cancel, small controls)
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.42 0.020 40); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.018 55); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: oklch(0.18 0.025 40); border-color: oklch(0.64 0.015 40); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.195 35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation row, default and active state
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 11px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.42 0.020 40); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.93 0.015 58); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 40); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: oklch(0.52 0.195 35 / 0.10); color: oklch(0.52 0.195 35); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base surface for content blocks (video card, playlist card)
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.99 0.004 55); border: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.015 58); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0.18 0.025 40 / 0.07); }

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Paste a video or playlist URL…" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.99 0.004 55); border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.018 55); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.18 0.025 40); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.195 35); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: oklch(0.52 0.195 35); }

narrative.overview: bWeb is a set of everyday creator tools (download, compress, watermark, redact, remove backgrounds, generate QR codes) that runs entirely on the user's own machine — no cloud, no uploads, no account. The design has to earn the trust that claim implies: calm, legible, never showy. It borrows its confidence from consumer products like Airbnb or Apple's own apps — clean surfaces, one warm accent doing real work, generous but not wasteful whitespace — rather than from developer tools or admin dashboards. The audience is explicitly non-technical: every screen should read as finished and self-explanatory, never like a tool that assumes prior configuration knowledge.
keyCharacteristics: One warm accent color (deep tomato/crimson, oklch hue 35) carries all interactive meaning
Flat-by-default surfaces with subtle tonal elevation, not glassy or gradient-heavy
Small, purposeful motion — present but never showy or decorative
A single sans typeface (Inter) at a disciplined 8-step type scale

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent color is active at a time. A screen never mixes two accent hues to indicate two different kinds of action.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Every font size traces back to one of the 8 steps in the --fs-* scale. A one-off pixel value is a bug, not a design choice.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a surface-2/surface-3 background shift before reaching for a shadow to indicate hierarchy.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent color active on screen at any time
Do use small, purposeful motion tied to a real state change
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for every animation added
Do trace every font-size and spacing value back to the existing scales
Do make every control understandable without documentation
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent color anywhere in the UI
Don't reach for glassmorphism, gradient text, or gradient-on-dark hero treatments
Don't use transition: all — list the exact properties being animated
Don't ship an interactive element with no visible :focus-visible state
Don't let a tab's design drift from the others
Don't make the interface feel like a developer tool with no polish
